title: Run FT-003 integrated verification and durable docs sync

gates.name: ep001-regression-suite
gates.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/access_admin tests/backend/api -k "ft001 or ft002 or ft003"

verify: All FT-003 behavior specs have direct executable traceability.

Integrated flow proves canonical Farm/tomato_001 bootstrap, first Boss bootstrap, Boss login, Boss-created Engineer, Engineer login, Boss Plant access grant through canonical Plant API, and safe admin audit entries.
Non-Boss admin route denial, last-Boss protection, password exclusion, audit safety, and no-store response behavior pass together.
Completed Foundation, FT-001, and FT-002 focused regressions remain green.
Feature, RTM, epic, changelog, and routing docs synchronize only the FT-003-owned result and do not claim FT-016 PWA, Plant operations, Safety Gate, agent, dataset, or downstream feature completion.
Feature-level /red-verify --feature FT-003 is recommended after all FT-003 tasks close because admin/security semantic drift is material.
constraints: Do not add new FT-003 product behavior during the integration/docs gate; route implementation gaps back to the owning task/spec.
Do not mark FT-016 PWA/admin UI, Plant operations, Safety Gate, agent, dataset, or downstream feature scope complete.
Record only reproducible redacted evidence and distinguish PostgreSQL authority checks from test-double-only evidence.
Keep REQ lifecycle updates limited to evidence actually owned by FT-003.
invariants: Foundation, FT-001, and FT-002 behavior remain regression constraints.
Memory Bank lifecycle and RTM statements must match task evidence exactly.
Secrets and auth material never enter evidence or durable docs.
Admin UI notices and audit display text remain presentation-only and absent from agent context.
verification_targets: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/access_admin tests/backend/api -k "ft001 or ft002 or ft003"
Trace FT-003-BHV-001 through FT-003-BHV-003 to concrete passing tests and task evidence.
Check every FT-003 card remains schema-valid, indexed once, dependency-acyclic, and linked to the direct canonical subset.
Check durable docs report only FT-003-owned requirement evidence and explicit deferred PWA/downstream scopes.
purpose: Provide one coherent integration and durable synchronization boundary for the completed FT-003 implementation queue.
success_outcome: FT-003 evidence is complete and internally consistent, completed Foundation/FT-001/FT-002 behavior regresses cleanly, and durable docs are ready for feature-level semantic review.
anti_goals: No new feature implementation hidden inside the gate.
No Plant operations, Safety Gate, agent, or dataset feature closure.
No overclaiming unavailable PostgreSQL or cross-feature evidence.

forbidden_scope: Plant operations, Safety Gate, agent, dataset, or downstream feature implementation
stop_conditions: Any FT-003 prerequisite task is not done or its evidence contradicts a canonical spec.
Focused integration exposes missing behavior that requires widening an earlier task or public contract.
PostgreSQL authority claims cannot be distinguished from test-double evidence.
Docs sync would overclaim shared requirement or downstream feature completion.
Evidence contains secrets or auth material.
